title: Gas hike, diesel rollback looms Tuesday, Oct. 13

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mixed oil price movements will be seen by motorists this week, with gasoline posting another hike and diesel dropping by about ₱3 per liter. Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary Sharon Garin, in a media briefing, said gasoline prices will increase anew by ₱1.56 per liter beginning Tuesday. Likewise, serosene prices will go up by ₱1.77 per liter. Diesel, meanwhile, will have a price cut of at least ₱3.01 per liter.
